title: SKE Crystal Watermelon Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Watermelon Ice flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid provides a cooling and refreshing experience, combining the fresh taste of juicy watermelon with a crisp menthol finish. This e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy a fruity yet invigorating vape, especially during the warm weather. Part of SKE's Crystal Nic Salts range, this e-liquid features nicotine salts for a smoother throat hit, suitable for those new to vaping or looking for a less harsh experience. The 50VG/50PG ratio makes it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices, ensuring a balanced delivery of flavour and vapour. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
